mentions.name: Arbiter
mentions.description: A deterministic judgement engine for disagreeing inputs, built on research into conflict logics. Its input interface is currently shaped for LLMs and it also exposes a normal API; planned next steps include an ingest pipeline and a more sophisticated logic engine.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's a deterministic judgement engine for disagreeing inputs. The input interface is shaped for LLMs now, but there's no particular reason it has to stay limited that way & it has a normal API.

evidence.value: It's a deterministic judgement engine for disagreeing inputs. The input interface is shaped for LLMs now, but there's no particular reason it has to stay limited that way & it has a normal API.
